title: Newton–Raphson for √2
caption: Start at x₀ = 1 on f(x) = x² − 2. The tangent there (gradient 2) meets the axis at x₁ = 1.5; the tangent at x₁ (gradient 3) meets it at x₂ = 1.4167. Each tangent lands much closer to the root √2 = 1.41421.
alt: Parabola x squared minus 2 with the tangent at x = 1 crossing the axis at 1.5, and the tangent there crossing at 1.4167, close to the root 1.41421.
description: The curve is f(x) = x² − 2 for x from 0.9 to 1.7; it crosses zero at √2 = 1.41421.
At x₀ = 1, f = −1 and the gradient is 2. The tangent crosses zero at x₁ = 1 − (−1)/2 = 1.5.
At x₁ = 1.5, f = 0.25 and the gradient is 3. The tangent crosses zero at x₂ = 1.5 − 0.25/3 = 1.4167.
x₃ = 1.41422: the number of correct digits doubles each step.
